# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

import typing

import rosterkit.errors
import rosterkit.models

GAP = "  "


def contact_rows(students: typing.Iterable[rosterkit.models.Student]) -> typing.List[str]:
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by display name."""
    roster = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    if not roster:
        raise rosterkit.errors.ProjectError("no students to list")
    cells = []
    for student in roster:
        if not student.email:
            raise rosterkit.errors.ProjectError(
                f"no email for student {student.display_name} ({student.student_id})"
            )
        cells.append((student.display_name, student.section, student.email))
    widths = [0, 0]
    for name, section, _ in cells:
        widths[0] = max(widths[0], len(name))
        widths[1] = max(widths[1], len(section))
    rows = []
    for name, section, email in cells:
        rows.append(name.ljust(widths[0]) + GAP + section.ljust(widths[1]) + GAP + email)
    return rows
# end of file
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

import rosterkit.contacts
import rosterkit.errors
import rosterkit.models


def make(student_id, last, first, section, email):
    return rosterkit.models.Student(student_id, last, first, section, email)


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        students = [
            make("2", "Young", "Al", "B", "al@example.org"),
            make("1", "Adams", "Beatrice", "A", "bea@example.org"),
        ]
        rows = rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows(students)
        self.assertTrue(rows[0] == "Adams, Beatrice  A  bea@example.org")
        self.assertTrue(rows[1] == "Young, Al        B  al@example.org")

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        students = [make("1", "Adams", "Beatrice", "A", None)]
        with self.assertRaises(rosterkit.errors.ProjectError) as caught:
            rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows(students)
        self.assertTrue("Adams, Beatrice" in str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(rosterkit.errors.ProjectError):
            rosterkit.contacts.contact_rows([])
# end of file
EOF
